TCP_MODE.description: TCP scanning mode: 'tcp' (standard), 'stcp' (stealth), 'atcp' (aggressive stealth), or empty to disable.

UDP_MODE.description: UDP scanning mode: 'udp', 'sudp', 'audp', or empty to disable.

IGNORE_UDP.description: Disable detection for UDP traffic (set to true to ignore UDP packets).

IGNORE_ICMP.description: Disable detection for ICMP traffic (set to true to ignore ICMP packets).

IGNORE_HOSTS.description: List of IP addresses or CIDR ranges to exempt from scanning detection.

SCAN_MODE.description: Which traffic to monitor: 'tcp' (TCP SYN, FIN, etc.), 'udp' (UDP), or 'both'.

BLOCK_HOST.description: Automatically block detected attackers (by adding to /etc/hosts.deny or firewall rules).

BLOCK_TIME.description: Duration (seconds) to block a host before unblocking (set 0 for permanent block).

KILL_CMD.description: Custom command to run when blocking a host (e.g., for alerting or logging).

TCP_PORTS.description: TCP ports to monitor for scanning (lower-numbered services are common targets).

UDP_PORTS.description: UDP ports to monitor for scanning.

STRICT_TCP_SCAN.description: Enable detection of non-standard TCP scans (XMAS, NULL, FIN, SYN-ACK, etc.).

STRICT_UDP_SCAN.description: Enable detection of suspicious UDP patterns (e.g., fragmented packets, unusual ports).
